name: work-intake
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the tracker-read model changes incompatibly (e.g. multi-tracker support, or the WorkItem schema reaches a breaking major version).
spec_change_reason: In-flight guard (convergence): added the pure is_in_flight(item, in_flight_issue_refs) predicate and the Pull(in_flight_issue_refs=...) injected-set param that UNCONDITIONALLY EXCLUDES any candidate work_item whose issue ref (owner/repo#N) already has an OPEN loop PR, so the loop does not re-triage/re-implement work already in flight (the excluded issue is left open + untouched; a PULL exclusion, not a TRIAGE reject). Bounded scope: work-intake CONSUMES the set (threaded in by scheduling from existing verify-integrate open-PR / acted-ledger seams), adds no gh plumbing; default empty set = no-op (non-breaking).
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md already committed at 0.12.0 in spec-update commit c067967 (in-flight guard: is_in_flight + Pull(in_flight_issue_refs)); this cycle implements src+tests+baseline re-anchor against that committed spec
